changelog: Changing your name works — the app was writing it to a field the backend does not have, which is what "illegal argument" meant.
Switching a device on or off no longer fails with "Token expired" — that endpoint reports an expired session in a way the app was not recognising, so it never refreshed and retried.
Signing in with an email code now also sets up background alerts — until now only a brand-new account did, so Power Outage and Low Battery never fired for anyone else once the app was closed.
The founder code field no longer shows a working code as its example.
Onboarding asks what to call you before the first device, and that name becomes the one the app shows and the nickname on your account.
Notifications rows show a time again — the device never sends one for a live alarm, so the app remembers when it first saw it.
Feedback is the handoff's sheet now: title, two outlined fields and a filled Send Feedback button.
